user.title: Set up HAAPI
user.description: Create a HAAPI integration instance to manage REST API endpoints.

data_description.name: Name for this HAAPI instance (e.g., 'Production APIs', 'Dev APIs')

abort.no_endpoints: No endpoints configured yet. Add an endpoint first.

add_endpoint.title: Add API Endpoint
add_endpoint.description: Configure a new API endpoint. You can use Jinja2 templates in URL, headers, and body fields.

data_description.endpoint_name: A unique name for this API endpoint
data_description.url: The API endpoint URL (supports Jinja2 templates)
data_description.headers: Headers in 'Key: Value' format, one per line. For multiple headers, paste multiline content (e.g., 'Authorization: Bearer token' on one line, 'Content-Type: application/json' on the next)
data_description.body: Request body content. For multiline JSON/XML/text, paste your formatted content here (supports Jinja2 templates)
data_description.timeout: Request timeout in seconds (1-300). Default is 10 seconds
data_description.verify_ssl: Verify SSL certificates. Disable only for self-signed certificates (not recommended for production)
data_description.max_response_size: Maximum response body size in bytes (0-10000000). Set to 0 for unlimited. Default is 10240 bytes (10KB). Helps prevent database bloat from large responses
data_description.retries: Number of retry attempts for failed requests (0-5). Default is 0 (no retries). Retries on network errors and server errors (5xx status codes)
data_description.retry_delay: Delay in seconds between retry attempts (1-60). Default is 1 second

data_description.api_key: API key for API Key authentication (sent as X-API-Key header)

response_received.name: Response received
response_received.description: Triggers when an endpoint completes a call, regardless of the result.

status.name: Status code
status.description: Only trigger when the HTTP status code matches this value (0 means a network or timeout error). Leave empty to trigger on any status.

call_succeeded.name: Call succeeded
call_succeeded.description: Triggers when an endpoint completes with a 2xx status code.

call_failed.name: Call failed
call_failed.description: Triggers when a call fails: a network/timeout error (status 0) or an HTTP error (status 400 or higher).

response_changed.name: Response changed
response_changed.description: Triggers when the response body differs from the previous call to the endpoint.

status_changed.name: Status code changed
status_changed.description: Triggers when the HTTP status code differs from the previous call to the endpoint.

body_matches.name: Response body matches
body_matches.description: Triggers when the response body matches a regular expression.

pattern.name: Pattern
pattern.description: Regular expression to search for anywhere in the response body.

value_matches.name: Response value matches
value_matches.description: Triggers when a field in the JSON response body equals or matches a value.

path.name: Field path
path.description: Dotted path to the field, e.g. 'state' or 'ams.0.humidity' (list items by index).

equals.name: Equals
equals.description: Trigger only when the field equals this value (string comparison). Leave empty to skip.

pattern.name: Pattern
pattern.description: Trigger only when the field matches this regular expression. Leave empty to skip.

value_changed.name: Response value changed
value_changed.description: Triggers when a field in the JSON response body changes from the previous call.

path.name: Field path
path.description: Dotted path to the field, e.g. 'progress' or 'ams.0.humidity' (list items by index).

recovered.name: Recovered
recovered.description: Triggers when a call succeeds (2xx) after the previous call to the endpoint had failed.

went_down.name: Went down
went_down.description: Triggers when a call fails after the previous call to the endpoint had succeeded (2xx).

last_call_succeeded.name: Last call succeeded
last_call_succeeded.description: Passes when the endpoint's last call returned a 2xx status.

response_contains.name: Response contains
response_contains.description: Passes when the endpoint's last response body matches a regular expression.

pattern.name: Pattern
pattern.description: Regular expression to search for anywhere in the last response body.

value_is.name: Response value is
value_is.description: Passes when a field in the last JSON response body equals or matches a value.

path.name: Field path
path.description: Dotted path to the field, e.g. 'state' or 'ams.0.humidity' (list items by index).

equals.name: Equals
equals.description: Pass only when the field equals this value (string comparison). Leave empty to skip.

pattern.name: Pattern
pattern.description: Pass only when the field matches this regular expression. Leave empty to skip.

request.name: Request
request.description: Call a HAAPI endpoint and return its response (status, ok, body, headers) for use with response_variable.
